description.p: A native GTK4 + libadwaita desktop client for ShadowsocksR, linking the ssr-client-rs core in-process. Manage profiles, start and stop the proxy with one click, and let the desktop's system proxy follow along.

While enabled the application exposes exactly one TCP listening port: the SOCKS5 port produced by the SSR protocol pipeline. The listener address is fixed to 0.0.0.0 — point only trusted clients at it, or firewall it.
原生 GTK4 + libadwaita 的 ShadowsocksR 桌面客户端，进程内链接 ssr-client-rs 核心。管理配置、一键启停代理，并自动跟随桌面系统代理设置。 启用期间全应用只暴露一个 TCP 监听口：经 SSR 协议链路处理后的 SOCKS5 口。 监听地址固定为 0.0.0.0，请只让可信客户端访问或用防火墙限制。
First release: profile management, single-port enable/disable with automatic system-proxy snapshot and restore, zh-CN / en-US UI.
